ITEM 1 | Pale yellow scrambled-looking mass with soft, fluffy curds and small folds, with scattered orange-red chunks and bits of darker orange throughout; moist with slight sheen, crumbly and loosely clumped, spread across the center-left of the plate in an irregular mound about 9 cm by 8 cm and roughly 2 cm high | 150

ITEM 2 | Thin smear of orange-red liquid with slight sheen along the lower-right edge of the mound and across the plate surface, flowing and not holding shape, covering a small area about 4 cm by 2 cm | 10
